nb2_lite.texto: A photograph of the same person shown in the reference image. A young adult Spanish woman, olive skin turned sallow, dark hair damp and plastered to her forehead, slight build, in a white hospital gown. Lying back exhausted in an iron hospital bed just after a forceps delivery. Spanish people with olive to fair Mediterranean skin, dark brown to black hair and brown eyes. Small Wittenoom hospital ward 1963, iron beds, linoleum floor, louvred window. Pale diffuse window daylight, cool and flat. Medium shot, slightly high angle from the foot of the bed, shallow depth of field, 50mm lens, tray softly in focus. A grainy 35mm documentary photograph in the style of 1963, with muted colors and slight underexposure, in a dark-history realist style. The image has a 16:9 aspect ratio. No readable text, no signage, no labels.
